prohibition_lifted_by_exemption: The description names a medical or safety purpose. The exception in {citation} then applies, and the practice is not prohibited. It nevertheless remains emotion recognition and therefore falls under Annex III point 1(c), with all obligations for high-risk AI systems. The reason for the exception must be documented. Wording of the exception: {wording}
annex_i_third_party_assessment: It remains to be checked whether this product requires a third-party conformity assessment; only then does Article 6(1) apply.
annex_iii_area_with_keywords: The described use falls within the area {title!r} of Annex III (keywords: {keywords}).
annex_iii_area: The described use falls within the area {title!r} of Annex III.
exemption_case: Your description points to this case: {case} {precondition} Whoever relies on it bears the burden of proof: {follow_up_obligation}
gpai_model_provided: You provide a general-purpose AI model yourself. The obligations for providers of general-purpose AI models therefore apply.
gpai_systemic_risk_threshold: The stated training compute of {compute:.1e} floating-point operations reaches the threshold of {threshold:.0e}. {presumption}
trait_caveat: This obligation applies only if your system has the trait {traits}. Your description does not say — please check this yourself.
open_question_role: Are you a provider or a deployer? The provider develops the system and places it on the market under its own name; the deployer uses it under its own authority. The obligations differ considerably.
open_question_personal_data: Does the system process personal data, that is, information relating to an identifiable person? This decides whether data protection law applies as well.
open_question_human_oversight: Does a person review the result before it takes effect, and can they change it? This decides the derogation under Article 6(3).
open_question_profiling: Is the system used to create or evaluate profiles of individual people? If so, no derogation applies.
open_question_training_compute: How much compute was used for training, in floating-point operations? From 10^25 onwards, systemic risk is presumed.
open_question_thin_description: The description is still thin. The more precisely the purpose, the area of use and the affected persons are named, the more reliable the answer.
